- **Seller reputation:** Look for independent seller ratings or reviews of Brackmoor Sound and Ottervale Audio. I only saw the product pages, so I can't say whether either seller has a good record.
- **Checkout:** Check the final price at checkout. Tax, shipping, or a payment option could differ even though the listings match.
- **Ties:** If you find nothing else, pick whichever you trust more or whichever has the better checkout experience. Going by the listings, you'd lose nothing with either one.
